description: MainActivity.kt is the primary activity class that mediates the user interface for a Tic Tac Toe game. It binds views, handles user interactions, manages game state, and updates the UI accordingly. It interacts with external game logic and data models to maintain game flow and state persistence across configuration changes.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity binds the UI elements for the Tic Tac Toe game, manages the game state, handles user input, and updates the interface to reflect game progress, wins, or draws.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, binds views, restores state if available, and sets up click listeners.

methods.name: restoreFromBundle
methods.description: Restores game state from the saved instance state bundle, reconstructing the board, current player, winner, and draw status.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Serializes current game state into the bundle for state persistence across configuration changes.

methods.name: wireCellClicks
methods.description: Assigns click listeners to each of the 3x3 grid buttons.

methods.name: onCellClicked
methods.description: Handles user clicking a cell, delegates move to game logic if valid, and updates state.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game to initial state, clearing the board and updating the UI.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Updates the UI components to display the current game state, including the board, turn info, and game result.

methods.name: disableBoard
methods.description: Disables all grid buttons, preventing further moves after game end.

methods.name: enableBoardForAvailableMoves
methods.description: Enables only the empty grid buttons for subsequent moves.
